[PREFERENCE] The user is looking for healthy dinner ideas that use chicken breast.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided 10 healthy dinner ideas using chicken breast, including:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Grilled Chicken Fajitas: Marinate chicken breast in lime juice, olive oil, garlic, and spices; grill with bell peppers and onions; serve with whole wheat tortillas, avocado, and brown rice or quinoa.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Lemon Herb Chicken with Roasted Veggies: Season chicken with lemon zest, olive oil, and herbs; roast with vegetables like Brussels sprouts, carrots, and sweet potatoes.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Chicken and Mango Salad: Grill and slice chicken; mix with diced mango, red onion, cilantro, and lime juice; serve on mixed greens or whole grain rice.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Chicken and Spinach Stuffed Bell Peppers: Fill bell peppers with cooked chicken, spinach, feta cheese, and brown rice; bake until tender.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Korean-Style Chicken and Veggie Stir-Fry: Marinate chicken in soy sauce, honey, and gochujang; stir-fry with vegetables; serve with brown rice or cauliflower rice.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Chicken and Quinoa Bowl with Roasted Vegetables: Grill or bake chicken; serve on quinoa with roasted vegetables like asparagus, Brussels sprouts, and cherry tomatoes.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Chicken Caesar Wrap: Grill chicken; wrap in whole wheat tortilla with romaine lettuce, cherry tomatoes, and light Caesar dressing.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. Indian-Style Chicken Tikka Masala: Marinate chicken in yogurt, lemon juice, and spices; serve with creamy tomato sauce and basmati rice or naan.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 9. Chicken and Black Bean Chili: Shred or chop cooked chicken; add to black bean chili with tomatoes, onions, and bell peppers; serve with cornbread or crusty bread.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 10. Chicken and Avocado Salsa Tacos: Grill chicken; serve in tacos with avocado salsa, mixed greens, and whole wheat tortillas.
